items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: To me, jazz maybe I would, have associated it with Glenn Miller.

ctx.x: So basically, to answer your question, I was, for some reason, I was interested a lot in the fundamentals of music and the harmony, which is actually I discovered later on, that’s the job of a bassist. It’s not just to play a groove. To me that’s totally wrong. It’s to create a fundamental voice that is a voice by itself but always nourishing what the orchestra says, help the soloist of trying — exactly like Ron Carter put it just in a few words, I’m talking too much, Ron Carter said, “Our job is to find the good…

was playing accordion. I was not at all, the very few pieces that my sister used to listen to about classical music, that was okay. I could say I liked it but not enough to buy records or to want to know what was this music about. And jazz, I had no idea. To me, jazz maybe I would, have associated it with Glenn Miller. Maybe the name of Louis Armstrong.
So you didn’t fall in love with jazz right away.
